name: dzbuild-app-orders
description: A DZBuild app on Cloudflare Workers that polls new orders every minute and sends a Telegram message per order; order webhooks once the Worker has a domain of its own.

DZBUILD_CLIENT_ID.description: The `client_id` of your app (`dzapp_` + 20 hex characters) from the [DZBuild developer console](https://dzbuild.com/dashboard/developer).

DZBUILD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret (`dzas_` + 48 hex characters) shown once when you create the app. Set it with `npx wrangler secret put DZBUILD_CLIENT_SECRET` after the first deploy if the setup page does not ask for it.

DZBUILD_SIGNING_SECRET.description: The signing secret (64 hex characters) behind the toggle in the console; it signs webhooks and launch links. Set it with `npx wrangler secret put DZBUILD_SIGNING_SECRET` after the first deploy if the setup page does not ask for it.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: The bot token from @BotFather (`123456789:AA...`). Set it with `npx wrangler secret put TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` after the first deploy if the setup page does not ask for it. Without it the app records orders but sends nothing.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: The chat that receives the order messages: your user id, or a group id starting with `-100`. Send the bot a message, then read `chat.id` from `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates`.
